trends.name: Medicare Advantage Rate Boost
trends.summary: Trump administration finalizes better-than-feared 2.5% annual Medicare Advantage payment increase (vs. expected 1.0%), sending health insurers like UnitedHealth (UNH +11%) surging. This is a major market catalyst reshaping healthcare sector valuations and investor positioning.

trends.name: Iran Geopolitical Crisis & Oil Markets
trends.summary: Trump's Iran ceasefire deadline drives heightened Hormuz Strait tensions and market volatility. Despite Strait closure risks and Trump's 'not good enough' assessment, oil prices remain muted—a counterintuitive signal traders are parsing. Geopolitical tail risk dominates macro sentiment.

trends.name: AI Infrastructure & Energy Demand
trends.summary: Data center energy boom driving utilities and infrastructure plays like Black Stone Minerals and PSEG into AI infrastructure narratives. IBM's AI sting and power demand dynamics signal sustained investment opportunities in energy and compute infrastructure.

trends.name: Alphabet Valuation Debate & AI Competition
trends.summary: Alphabet faces 2026 critical test despite strong money positioning at 27x P/E. OpenAI's antitrust complaint against Musk ahead of April trial adds uncertainty. Competing narratives on AI leadership and regulatory risk dominate sentiment.

trends.name: Gold Liquidity Surge & Safe-Haven Demand
trends.summary: Gold trading volume tripled to $361B daily average in 2025 vs. $134B in 2021, now exceeding most major financial assets. Reflects sustained geopolitical uncertainty and inflation hedging demand amid macro volatility.

trends.name: Software Sector Recovery & Stock Selection
trends.summary: Software stocks face brutal stretch but 3-factor recovery thesis emerging around AI agentic business (see UiPath PATH discussion). Morgan Stanley identifies 'overlooked' AI stock as top pick. Sector inflection point signals opportunity after painful correction.

trends.name: Market Bottom Uncertainty & Valuation Risk
trends.summary: Technical indicators suggest S&P 500 likely hasn't hit bottom yet despite modest recent gains. Value stocks losing safe-haven status amid turbulence. Investors searching for richest opportunities but broader conviction lacking on entry points.

trends.name: Commerce Secretary Lutnick Epstein Testimony
trends.summary: Howard Lutnick set for May 6 House Oversight Committee interview regarding Epstein files. Political/regulatory uncertainty cloud over Trump administration officials adds tail risk to policy execution confidence.

trends.name: Private Credit Redemption Cascade Risk
trends.summary: Redemption requests at Blue Owl, Cliffwater triggering domino effects among private credit funds. Liquidity crunch in alternatives market signals potential broader credit stress and fund manager stress.

trends.name: Tax Refund & IRS Revenue Backdrop
trends.summary: Average tax refunds up $350 YoY as IRS deadline approaches, but cultural shift underway with Americans protesting via tax non-compliance. Adds fiscal/political uncertainty to revenue forecasts and consumer sentiment.

trends.name: Trump NATO & South Korea Tensions
trends.summary: Trump revisits Greenland grievances and criticizes South Korea's NATO contribution, signaling potential trade/security policy shifts. Geopolitical unpredictability adds risk premium to international markets and Asia exposure.

trends.name: Energy Cost Crisis & Policy Debate
trends.summary: Trump moves to scrap utility bill aid as Americans face $1,000+ average winter energy costs. Policy reversal amid affordability crisis signals potential inflation/wage growth pressure and political backlash risks.
